meta.title: Approach
meta.description: Transport is not an interchangeable service: it is designed from what the ground allows. Our approach, from engineering to contracting.

hero.title: Transport is designed with the ground first.
hero.lede: Transport is a cost item, a risk factor and a condition for business continuity. The energy transition and pressure on resources, human ones in particular, require decisions to move closer to physical reality and to the capacity that can actually be mobilised.

conviction.title: An interchangeable service, bought at the best price?
body: Transport is not reducible to that. Flows, time windows, drivers, equipment, infrastructure, energy resources and commitments determine the organisations that are really possible.
Two offers at the same price are not worth the same if one assumes a free dock at 6 am and the other a loaded return. Comparing prices without comparing what they assume is comparing labels.

ground.title: Six realities before the first price.

flows.name: Flows
flows.body: How much, how often, how regularly. A daily flow and a monthly flow call for neither the same transport nor the same contract.

slots.name: Time windows
slots.body: Dock windows and service lead times bound what can be chained. A shifted window can open a complementarity — or close one.

drivers.name: Drivers
drivers.body: A scarce resource, subject to driving and rest times. An organisation that ignores them exists only on paper.

equipment.name: Equipment
equipment.body: What can travel together, in what, and what is needed to load and unload.

energy.name: Infrastructure and energy
energy.body: Terminals, tracks, charging points, available power: what the territory allows, where you need it.

commitments.name: Commitments
commitments.body: Contracts in force, durations, deadlines. They say what is possible today and what becomes possible tomorrow.

levers.title: Levers to act, means to get there.
levers.lede: Controlling costs, reducing risks, securing capacity: those are the goals. Here is what makes them reachable.

collaboration.name: Collaboration
collaboration.body: First between the sites and subsidiaries of a group, where complementarities are most direct. Then with other shippers, when it brings extra value. Carriers are partners with whom to build commitments that can be met.

intermodal.name: Intermodal
intermodal.body: Rail, inland waterway, sea: one option among others, to be compared on full cost and service, not a bias.

ai.name: Artificial intelligence
ai.body: A means to explore more organisations and to read heterogeneous information faster. It helps prepare the decision; it does not take it for you.

datasets.name: Datasets
datasets.body: Services, operators, infrastructure: they document the ground. Each is dated and bounded, and what we show of them is set out on the Datasets page.

ladder.title: Five levels of knowledge, never mixed.
ladder.lede: Precision strengthens the argument. Every object in our studies — a site, a link, a partner — sits on this scale, and each level is earned differently.

cta.title: Your ground has its own realities.
cta.body: Let’s talk about your flows, your sites and your contracts.

meta.title: Solutions
meta.description: Five capabilities for five decisions: transport engineering, tender preparation, carrier search, offer comparison, contract management.

hero.title: Five capabilities, for five decisions.
hero.lede: Each page answers a decision you have to make — not a software name. Application names remain available below.

apps.title: The applications behind these capabilities.
apps.lede: You do not need to know them to understand the offer. Here they are, with what each one does.

design4ward.name: Design4ward
design4ward.body: The shipper’s cockpit: flow mapping, engineering studies (cross-dock, modal shift, loops, electrification), tender preparation.

compute4ward.name: Compute4ward
compute4ward.body: The cost and emissions model the studies draw on.

modal4ward.name: Modal4ward
modal4ward.body: The catalogue of multimodal services (rail, inland waterway, sea) and its assistant.

connect4ward.name: Connect4ward
connect4ward.body: Ingestion and standardisation of transport data, publication of shared datasets, the contract register.

carrierbridge.name: CarrierBridge
carrierbridge.body: The price grids and energy indices exchanged with carriers.

meta.title: The company
meta.description: Pool4ward supports companies from engineering to contracting in transport. Our conviction, our way of working.

hero.title: Bring an idea of an organisation closer to its realisation.
hero.lede: Pool4ward supports companies from transport engineering to contracting. We believe transport decisions are better taken close to the ground.

items.name: Price does not say everything.
items.body: It depends on what the offer assumes: time windows, equipment, drivers, energy, commitments.

items.name: Data without structure is useless.
items.body: Transport decisions need shared, dated and bounded data — not files in circulation.

items.name: The value is between sites.
items.body: The most direct complementarities are first found between the sites and subsidiaries of one group.

items.name: Execution matters more than analysis.
items.body: A plan that does not turn into commitments that can be met remains a diagram.

how.title: Evidence before promises.
body: We do not publish client logos or savings figures that could not be verified. We describe what our tools do, we say what our datasets cover, and we distinguish what is referenced from what is confirmed.
Our analyses cite their sources. When data is missing, we write so.

meta.title: Discuss your transport plan
meta.description: Talk to Pool4ward about your transport flows, sites and contracts.

hero.title: Let’s talk about your transport plan.
hero.lede: Tell us in a few lines what you are trying to decide. We reply with a short conversation, to see whether your flows, sites and contracts lend themselves to another organisation.
